reviews.comment: Dr. Strganac was the highlight of last semester. He's very kind and funny, and his lectures were very helpful. He graded pretty tough but gave good feedback on homework and exams, and was happy to help when I had questions. The material is very interesting as well, I'd definitely take this class again.

Don't know how anyone could do well in this class. His lectures make no sense at all, and he goes off on tangents. Makes so many mistakes and just laughs it off likes its nothing. The homework problems were so hard, and you basically have to teach yourself from the textbook. I ended up Q dropping, but because I changed majors. Avoid at all costs.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: First of all, Strganac is a great guy and I have no problem with him at all. I, personally, am not a fan of his teaching methods. He is soft spoken and hard to follow at times. The lectures are not very engaging but he tries and if you can follow what's going on, you'll be fine. Expect a lot of work in this class. Take advantage of his office hours

He is extremely soft spoken and hard to understand during lecture. He also screws up constantly and begs for good ratings at the end of the semester. Grades extremely hard. If he doesn't like the method you used to solve a problem he will not give you the credit you deserve. Occasionally, he does make a good joke during lecture.

AMAZING professor! He knows his stuff and is willing to help you if something is unclear. He worked with NASA for 20 something' years so he'll share stories, unclassified ones of course. The workload won't be easy, but it's not impossible. Enjoy it!
